      "rationale": "Allows txindex to run concurrently with block pruning, resolving a long-standing constraint where users had to store the full raw block history to index transactions. Pruned nodes can now retain or partially build a txindex and surface block hashes for pruned blocks on demand."

      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Surfaces missing block hashes via structured RPC error data when querying pruned transactions, enabling clients to fetch missing blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer."
    },
